title: Case 037: Profile Name Typo
initial_request: Please correct the spelling of my name in my H&V profile. It shows “Elowen Mar”; my correct name is “Elowen Marr”.
overview: Elowen Marr escalated a profile-name spelling error after seeing “Elowen Mar” in H&V’s secure portal. Following identification checks on a call, the agent opened a protected name review and referred the correction request to the data team. No supporting documents were supplied, and the profile name remains unchanged while the request is reviewed.

next_action.summary: The agent opened the protected name review and referred HV-037 to the data team to check the basis for the correction under H&V procedure.

outcome: The secure portal journal confirms that the correction request was received for review. The name has not been corrected; the data team may request supporting information through the secure process.

events.body: Profile status: The name displayed in your profile is “Elowen Mar”.

After completing H&V’s identification checks, I explained that my profile shows “Elowen Mar” but my correct name is “Elowen Marr”. Please escalate a correction request; I understand the data team may ask for supporting information.

I have opened the protected name review and referred HV-037 for checking under procedure. The customer has requested a spelling correction; please determine what supporting information is required. No profile change has been made.
I have logged HV-037 as received for review. The basis for the correction has not yet been validated, and the profile name remains unchanged.
Journal status: Your correction request has been received for review. Your profile name has not been changed; any supporting information required will be requested through the secure process.
